action: [FILE] work/search_ddg.py --- #!/usr/bin/env python3 import urllib.request, re, os from urllib.parse import unquote, urlparse, parse_qs query = 'upwork workflow automation' url = f'https://html.duckduckgo.com/html/?q={query.replace(" ", "+")}' headers = {'User-Agent': 'Mozilla/5.0 (Windows NT 10.0; Win64; x64) AppleWebKit/537.36'} req = urllib.request.Request(url, headers=headers) try: with urllib.request.urlopen(req, timeout=10) as resp: html = resp.read().decode('utf-8', errors='ignore') except Exception as e: html = "" print(f"Error fetching: {e}") # 匹配 DuckDuckGo 搜索结果 items = re.findall(r'(.*?)', html, re.S) lines = [] for link, title in items[:3]: clean_title = re.sub(r'<.*?>', '', title).strip() # 解析 DuckDuckGo 的重定向链接获取真实 URL if 'uddg=' in link: parsed = urlparse(link) qs = parse_qs(parsed.query) real_link = unquote(qs.get('uddg', [link])[0]) else: real_link = link lines.append(f"- Title: {clean_title}\n URL: {real_link}\n Description: (自动抓取未实现)\n") content = "\n".join(lines) if lines else "No results found or blocked by captcha." os.makedirs('data', exist_ok=True) with open('data/search_results.md', 'w', encoding='utf-8') as f: f.write(content) print("Search results saved to data/search_results.md") print("---") print(content) [RUN] python3 work/search_ddg.py [RESULT_CHECK] 命令输出包含 "Search results saved to data/search_results.md" 且生成 data/search_results.md 文件
